name: Estelle
source:
Though a young adult in her early twenties, Estelle has spent most of her life sheltered and coddled by her overprotective parents. 

She dreams of being a knight like her mother, the famous Cressida, who defeated the wicked demon queen, Gunhild. She wants to become a brave knight, but her clumsiness often gets the better of her.

Estelle wants dearly to be brave and strong, but she's a shy girl with self-esteem issues. Kind-hearted to a fault, she puts others before herself, and often works herself up unnecessarily. She's naïve and a little too trusting, but has a great capacity for love, and is surprisingly good at settling arguments.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1351370/Sakura_Knight_3/]Steam[/url]]
